prompts.name: wood
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless grayscale surface-detail texture for an existing restrained rounded Unreal Engine mountain railway station. Square 2048 by 2048 composition, orthographic flat material scan filling every pixel. This is a material source, not a scene illustration. Neutral medium-gray luminance centered around 50%, moderately low contrast from about 30% to 70%. No color tint, no illumination gradient, no ambient occlusion, no directional shadows, no perspective, no text, no labels, no border, no objects, no transparency. Edges must tile seamlessly. Dense fine hand-painted game-art detail, gentle and elegant rather than gritty or photoreal. Surface: painted and softly weathered timber grain. Fine wavy parallel grain flowing strictly left-to-right, sparse tiny elongated knots, gentle pore streaks and subtle worn paint microtexture. No plank borders or gaps; those exist in geometry. Keep very large-scale brightness uniform.
